series.admin: Accessible name of the band holding the series' create-event door, shown only to those who may run it.
series.empty: A series page with no tournaments in it.
series.honours.fewer: Button collapsing the series' list of past winners back to the first few.
series.honours.more: Button expanding the series' list of past winners; {n} is how many more there are. Keep the <b> tags around the number.
series.honours.winners: Micro label over a series's roll of winners; {n} is how many there are.
series.index.column.events: Column of the series list: how many events each series has held.
series.index.column.series: Column of the series list: the series' name.
series.index.column.tournaments: Column of the series list: how many tournaments each series has held.
series.index.description: Search and link-preview description of the series list. Dizzy is the site's name.
series.index.empty: The series list when the site has none.
series.index.title: Heading and tab title of the list of every tournament series. A series is a run of recurring tournaments.
series.masthead.all: Link back from one series' page to the list of every series.
series.table.column.event: Column of a series' tournament table: the event each tournament belonged to.
series.table.column.format: Column of a series' tournament table: Singles, Doubles and so on.
series.table.column.game: Column of a series' tournament table: the game played.
